checkpoint_review: The Router's checkpoint verdicts are mostly reasonable. The Geometry_and_Silhouette and Material_and_Context checkpoints are correctly marked as testable and present. The Functional_Components checkpoints are correctly marked as untestable since only covers are visible. However, the Router was slightly lenient on the 'Spine shows staple binding marks' checkpoint - while staples are visible, they're not clearly showing binding marks in the traditional sense, more just the spine edge. The 'Periodical format' checkpoint reasoning is good with issue numbers visible.
artifact_review: The Router identified two minor artifacts: text_gibberish on the barcode (severity 1.5) and texture_anomaly on right comic edges (severity 1.0). The image_text_auditor evidence reveals significant text rendering issues that the Router underestimated. Multiple text blocks have low confidence scores and garbled content: 'Sian' instead of 'STAR', 'nEXT' instead of 'NEXT', 'GENERATIO' missing the N, 'TRET' instead of 'TREK', 'SiaRTREK' instead of 'STAR TREK', 'ISOM' instead of 'IS ON', 'TRECASE' instead of 'THE CASE', 'GMARL' instead of 'MARVEL'. These are not just minor distortions but clear text generation failures. The topology_boundary_auditor mask shows fragmentation issues with disconnected components, suggesting boundary integrity problems. The Router's severity ratings were too conservative given the extent of text corruption.
alignment_reasoning: 6 out of 9 checkpoints passed (3 untestable). Fine-grained classifier confirms comic book class with high confidence (logit 7.93). However, text rendering quality significantly impacts the 'bold title typography' checkpoint. The core comic book structure is present but text corruption affects functional components.
artifact_reasoning: Router identified 2 minor artifacts but underestimated severity. Image text auditor reveals extensive text corruption across multiple title elements with confidence scores below 0.75 for critical text. Topology auditor shows boundary fragmentation. Text gibberish is more severe than Router's 1.5 rating, closer to 3.0 for multiple title elements. Texture anomalies are present but less severe.
key_defects: Extensive text corruption in comic titles (STAR TREK rendered as Sian TRET, SiaRTREK)
Missing letters in text (GENERATIO instead of GENERATION)
Garbled author names and subtitle text
Inconsistent text rendering quality across different text blocks
